title: Shrimp and Syrian Pilaf
description: A flavorful and vibrant shrimp dish inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine, served with a side of aromatic Syrian pilaf.

ingredients.name: lively
ingredients.amount: 1/2 cup, chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or cilantro)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the remaining oil and any accumulated shrimp juices.
Stir in the chopped herbs and lemon juice.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and toss to combine with the pilaf mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
